slides.headline: Stop drowning in debug noise
slides.lead: Choose the PHP error types you care about and silence everything else.
bullets: Notices, deprecations, warnings and strict errors - each on its own switch
Display mode: inherit, always on, or always off
Optional MU-plugin dropin filters errors before other plugins load

slides.headline: Toggle debug constants without FTP
slides.lead: Flip WP_DEBUG, WP_DEBUG_LOG, WP_DEBUG_DISPLAY, SCRIPT_DEBUG and SAVEQUERIES from the admin.
bullets: wp-config.php is patched in place
Timestamped backup before every write
Commented-out defines are never touched

slides.headline: Read debug.log inside wp-admin
slides.lead: Color-coded log with pagination, live polling, download and one-click clear.
bullets: Severity colors for fatal, warning, notice and cron lines
Tail-read keeps multi-megabyte files light
Download or clear the log in one click

slides.headline: See every cron event at a glance
slides.lead: Find overdue events, orphaned hooks and duplicate schedules in one table.
bullets: Run any event immediately
Delete orphaned hooks safely
Source detection shows which plugin scheduled it

slides.headline: Find the transients bloating your options table
slides.lead: Every database transient with size and expiry, plus a bulk purge for expired rows.
bullets: Sort by size and expiration
Delete single transients
Purge all expired rows in one click

slides.headline: Find what slows down every request
slides.lead: The heaviest autoloaded options, sorted by size, with warning thresholds.
bullets: Top 200 autoloaded rows
Size warnings above 800 KB or 100 rows
Spot plugin bloat before it hurts response time

slides.headline: See every outgoing HTTP call
slides.lead: Capture WordPress HTTP API requests with status, transport and duration.
bullets: Captures wp_remote_get and wp_remote_post via http_api_debug
Sensitive query parameters are masked automatically
Up to 100 entries with a 6-hour TTL

slides.headline: Every runtime constant in one place
slides.lead: Debug, security, database, auth and path constants grouped by category.
bullets: Database passwords, auth keys and salts stay masked
Grouped by category for fast scanning
Read-only reference - nothing is changed
